messages:
Ibrahim: Quick shout — three bits of good news! Sana got promoted to Staff PM :tada:, Omar and his partner hit their 1-year anniversary yesterday 💕, and Bea welcomed a baby boy this morning 🍼. Could we do a small celebration table + card tomorrow?
Sana: wow omg thank you!! super excited to keep building with you all ❤️
Omar: easy evening dinner for us, no gifts needed — but appreciated :smile:
Bea: he
rrived at 6:12am, 8lb 1oz. name is Milo. pics in #off-topic-photos when i figure out wifi haha
Ibrahim: Poll — react with one: 1️⃣ cake in kitchen @4pm, 2️⃣ group card + flowers, 3️⃣ money pool for present, 4️⃣ virtual-only (no treats)
Sana: 2️⃣ from me, plus congrats y'all!!
Bea: 1️⃣ is fine too if y'all want to swing by quickly. GF option pls
Omar: 3️⃣ I can start a collection link.
Kudos-bot: Sana promoted -> Staff Product Manager. +1 kudos badge awarded :medal: 
CalendarBot: Event created: "Celebrate Sana, Omar, Bea" on 2026-03-24 16:00 in Main Kitchen. Invite sent to #random.
Ibrahim: I'll grab a small cake + GF slices. Omar DM me for the collection link. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
